description: Defines the CartProducts class representing products added to a shopping cart in an online grocery ordering system. It includes product details such as name, image URL, quantity, net price, discount, and product ID, along with constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: CartProducts
classes.description: A Java class modeling a product in the shopping cart, encapsulating product attributes and providing methods for accessing and modifying these attributes.

methods.name: CartProducts
methods.description: Constructor initializing all product details including name, quantity, net price, discount, image URL, and product ID.

methods.name: CartProducts
methods.description: Overloaded constructor initializing product ID, name, quantity, and net price.

methods.name: getImgUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the product image.

methods.name: setImgUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the product image.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product.

methods.name: setnetPrice
methods.description: Sets the net price of the product.

methods.name: getDiscount
methods.description: Returns the discount percentage applied to the product.

methods.name: setDiscount
methods.description: Sets the discount percentage for the product.

methods.name: getNetPrice
methods.description: Returns the net price of the product (possibly after discount calculation).
